question: As at 30 September 2025, how many claims were open?
final_text:
As at 30 September 2025, 1,542 claims were open.

I counted claims reported on or before 30 September 2025 that either had no closed date or were closed after that date. The claim transactions have no reopen type, so I took the closed date as final.

ANSWER: 1542

input.query: select txn_type, cost_type, count(*), min(txn_date), max(txn_date) from claim_txn group by all;

select count(*), count(closed_date), sum(case when report_date<='2025-09-30' and (closed_date is null or closed_date>'2025-09-30') then 1 end), sum(case when closed_date<report_date then 1 end), max(report_date), max(closed_date) from claim;
